svg.text: keys and values: the source, read in order by the encoder RNN
query: the target, written one step at a time
two rows, each already in order — no one has to be told who came first
self-attention (2016; all of the architecture by 2017): one sequence
queries, keys and values: all from this one row
every output reads every input; no arrow runs along the row
one row, a set: permute it and the outputs permute — add position (W5)
